description:
Configure strict shift enforcement for the 'Survey Team'.

1. Go to the Shifts section and create a new Shift with:
   - Shift ID: SURVEY_EVE
   - Shift Name: Evening Survey Block
   - Start Time: 1700 (5:00 PM)
   - Shift Length: 0500 (5 hours)
   - Weekdays: All days selected

2. Go to User Groups, modify the existing 'SURVEY' (Survey Team) group:
   - Set Shift Enforcement to: ALL
   - Select the 'SURVEY_EVE' shift in the Allowed Shifts list.

3. Save your changes.
